title: Compliance sync + spot-check checklist (1:1 prep)
content:
Purpose:
Quick personal prep notes and checklist for the upcoming 1:1 with Marcus (compliance lead) and the external auditor touchpoint we have planned. This is a scratchpad — keep messy.

Meeting goal:
- Confirm evidence status for top 8 SOC2/ISO controls we promised to produce this quarter.
- Surface any vendor gaps that need compensating controls before the auditor walkthrough.
- Agree owners + deadlines for missing artifacts so we can close before the formal audit window.

Agenda (15-20m):
1) Quick status recap (2-3m)
2) Walk the checklist: evidence present / needs work (10m)
3) Vendor risk flags and mitigations (3-5m)
4) Confirm action owners and dates (2m)

Checklist (spot-check items) — mark as OK / Needs evidence / Open risk:
- Logical access reviews (TSC: Access Controls) — last review 2026-01-28 — evidence: access-review-report-2026-01.pdf (Drive). TODO: get signed approval from Leah (HR).
- MFA enforcement on service accounts — status: partially enforced; automation gap for legacy batch jobs. Mitigation: run weekly rotate script and add alert. Owner: Marcus.
- Privileged account inventory (who has admin rights) — evidence: admin-inventory.csv (in Drive) but missing timestamped exports. ACTION: run export 2026-03-09, attach to Confluence.
- Encryption at rest (cloud storage) — OK for primary buckets (AWS KMS), need key rotation log. ACTION: ops to provide rotation record (ticket JIRA-4921). Owner: SRE.
- Change management (deployment approvals, PR reviews) — PR policy exists but sample of approvals for Jan-Feb missing. Grab 3 PR examples from serving-runtime repo and note link. Owner: DevRel to help pull.
- Incident response tabletop evidence — we have playbook doc + 2025-10 tabletop notes. Need post-tabletop action list closure evidence. Owner: SRE (Leah).
- Vendor risk: proof of due diligence (vendor questionnaires + contracts) — see vendor matrix.
- Logging & retention: centralized logs (30d retention) — confirm log export to SIEM and provide retention policy doc.

High-priority vendor flags (quick):
- DataLabeler Inc. — no SOC2 attestation on file, handles low-volume PII for labeling. Risk: medium-high. Mitigation options: contract addendum requiring encryption in transit at minimum, data minimization, and short retention. ACTION: Marcus to request vendor questionnaire and escalate to legal.
- VectorStoreCo (embeddings datastore) — has SOC2 Type II but not full encryption configuration documented. Need config snapshot. ACTION: Ops to pull bucket configs + KMS key details.
- ExternalMonitoringLLC — monitoring agent runs with broad host access. Consider reducing scope or move to read-only. ACTION: Open ticket to limit privileges and capture change log.

Questions for the auditor (to confirm in the call):
- For vendors without SOC2, what level of compensating control is acceptable for a Type II audit? (expect: documented risk assessment + contractual controls + internal monitoring)
- Can we present a rolling evidence package (links + exports) or do they require packaged PDFs?
- Auditor preference on raw logs vs filtered extracts for sampling.

Evidence locations (notes to self):
- Confluence: /SEC/SOC2 readiness (main checklist, control mappings)
- Drive folder: Evidence bucket (see linked_artifacts) — subfolders by control
- GitHub: serving-runtime PR samples (search label: soc2-evidence)
- JIRA: JIRA-4589 (evidence backlog), JIRA-4921 (kms rotation)

Immediate action items (owner / due):
- Marcus: request DataLabeler questionnaire + contract addendum draft — due 2026-03-10.
- Leah: export privileged account inventory with timestamps — due 2026-03-09.
- SRE (Ops): provide KMS key rotation log and VectorStoreCo config snapshot — due 2026-03-11.
- DevRel: assemble 3 PR change examples showing approval flow — due 2026-03-09.
- Avery (me): compile a one-page evidence index (links + short description) and share in Slack #security — due 2026-03-10.

Risks I'm worried about (notes):
- Evidence fragmentation: auditors dislike hunting. Make sure each control has a single, timestamped artifact.
- Legacy batch jobs without MFA/service-account rotation are an easy fail. Priority to show compensating monitoring.
- Vendors with limited attestations are highest time sink — start legal loop early.

Back-of-envelope timeline to be audit-ready for the next readout (audit window mid-April):
- Mar 8-10: collect artifacts (this sprint)
- Mar 11-14: remediation for quick gaps (rotate keys, tighten scopes)
- Mar 15-20: internal dry-run with auditor checklist
- Apr 1-10: final packaging and executive sign-off

Notes to mention in the 1:1 (scripts/snippets):
- "Marcus — I want to confirm we can get vendor questionnaires from Legal by next Tuesday; if not, we need to escalate to execs."
- "Leah — can you also attach the post-tabletop closure items to the tabletop doc so auditors can see closure evidence?"

Loose thoughts / things to ask later:
- Should we spin up a temporary evidence bundle (zip) that mirrors auditor expectations? Might save repeats.
- Consider a short automated snapshot job that exports admin inventory and auth logs weekly (put results in Drive) — follow-up with SRE roadmap.

Bottom line (what I'll walk into the call saying):
- We have most artifacts but a few critical vendor and key-rotation pieces are outstanding. I want clear owners and dates so we can present a cohesive package to the auditor.

End of scratchpad.

(Will tidy and move key items to Confluence after the sync.)
